book.name: iMatiu
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iMatiu

content: Ama oyodzɛ mi onosa
Ngwi a mba iYesu mi iBɛtlɛhɛn mi iJudia duu nɛta, iHerude li utɔ mi onɔ nani, inggisɛ ama oyodzɛ mi onosa wa kaka iJerosalin,
le byita gbɛɛ, <<Ongwɛ ongwu a mba nli Utɔ mgbi emi iJuda nɛ, a kyon ladzɛ ole? Lubana eyi di mcɛ mgban mi onosa, ngwi eyi ba owa sunun aani.>>
Ngwi utɔ iHerude fwo odzɛ nɛ ngha nɛ, i kakan ewo bɛyi emi iJerosalin duu.
O kwu engyukwo ama ofifɛ mgbi Imgbasho bɛyi ama otso ola duu kwakye, o byi ma gbɛɛ li mi ole ngwi a ka mba iMedzaya ma?
A nyan gbɛɛ: <<Li mi iBɛtlɛhɛn mi iJudia, Lubana li ungwɔ ngwi oyegbɔ tsekise lɔ gbɛɛ:

content.text: o ka yama li igeli oyɛyikpa mi iJudia ba;
lubana li mbi abu ngwi inggisɛ

content: Ta iHerude kwu ama oyodzɛ ntona ela daada di byi ma ita klɛklɛ ni ongwu ye onɔ ngwi mcɛ na tsetu ma mani.
O si nu ma ofɛ lu iBɛtlɛhɛn di nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Lu ka pitan saan na. Ni ema ka din taman yɛ wa nya ani, adzi ni ani kpaa ka su nun.>>
Ngwi a fwo odzɛ ngwi utɔ gbɔ nɛ, a tasɛ lu ta mcɛ ongwi a di mi onosa ma gbe ma teyi nghataa ka kwulɛsɛ mi imbe ngwi ongwɛ na ladzɛ mani.
Onɔ ngwi a di mcɛ na ma, a dzɛ yi atsa kwuba.
Ta ama oyodzɛ kaka ozu di ongwɛ yi onɔn iMeri, a kwɛsɛ su nun, nɛ a kwulu igbe mgbi ama dulu abashi, engyie ogbungbɛ yi iMire
gbe ghan umba.
Nɛ ama oyodzɛ ntona yɛ nyɛ ofɛ oka lu ɛsɛ udɛ ma, lubana Imgbasho tsekise woma elela kwo ma adɔ gbɛɛ nu ma ka yɛ nyɛ mbi iHerude wuba.
A tsinya lu Igyibiti

Onɔ ngwi ama oyodzɛ lu dzita emi iMeri nɛ, ongyesɔ mgbi Otsɛ wa tsetu iJose mi elela owoowo nyan gbɛɛ: <<IHerude ka wa pita ongwɛ nɛ gbɛɛ ni ongwu ngwɔn. Nghanɛ kyato, kyelu ongwɛ yi onɔn tsinya lu Igyibiti, to ele na nghataa ni ani wa nya ema gbɛɛ ni ema kyɛɛ yɛ se.>>
IJose kyato una mi otu na, kyi kyelu ongwɛ yi onɔn, lu Igyibiti.
O dzɛ ele nghataa ba onɔ ngwi iHerude wa kwulu. Ungwɔnɛ kyɔ ikye onu odzɛ ngwi Otsɛ Imgbasho gbɔ nyɛ mbi oyegbɔ gbɛɛ, <<Ani kwu Ongwani ela tasɛ mi Igyibiti,>> ma yɛɛ otsitsi.
Ɛngbɛ ongwɔɔngwɔ

Onɔ ngwi iHerude difwi dafi ama oyodzɛ ntona kyɔn ikwangha ewo nɛ, eka kplɔkɔ lon. O noola gbɛɛ nu ma kye ngwɔlu ali ongwongyulɔ ama mmɛ onova efa yɛyikpa sini mi iBɛtlɛhɛn bɛyi agwɔ ama nwatse dɔn duu. O gbɔdzɛ nɛ mi ikye odzɛ ngwi ongwu fwo mbi ama oyodzɛ ntonani.
Ta odzɛ ngwi oyegbɔ iJeremia teyi gbɔ ma yɛɛ otsitsi gbɛɛ:

content.text: iRacɛ le makwɔ ikye ɛngbɛ mgban,

content: Oyɛ lu iNadzareti
Ngwi iHerude kwulu nyɛ nɛ, ongyesɔ mgbi Otsɛ kɛ mbi iJose mi elela owoowo mi Igyibiti
ka gbɛɛ, <<kyato, kyelu ongwɛ yi onɔn, yɛ lu ɛsɛ Israi, ikyesinɛ ama nle fya ongwɔ ongwɛ nɛ ma kwulu wa.>>
Man iJose kyato, kyi kyelu ongwɛ yi onɔn yɛ luba Israi.
Nghaduu ngwi iJose fwo gbɛɛ Acelusi gyutɔ gbikye otsɔn iHerude mi iJudia nɛ, o wimio oka kaka ele, a di won elela kwon adɔ nɛman, o yɛ lu ayɛsɛ iGalalia
ka dzɛ igeli ngwi a kwun di iNadzareti nani. Nɛ odzɛ ngwi oyegbɔ tsekise gbɔgbɛɛ: <<A ka kwun di inggisɛ iNadzareti,>> na mbwumbwo.

footnotes.text: IMire li otse onu ungwɔ bwa ba.
